title: Additivity of the integral line class after change of site
statement:
theorem tower_lineBundleEtaleClass_mul (T : Scheme.{u}) (L M : T.Pic) :
    lineBundleEtaleClass T (L * M) =
      lineBundleEtaleClass T L + lineBundleEtaleClass T M

source.place: paragraph (2), the integral Picard class, change of site and constant-system realization

proof.text: The Picard-to-H1 map sends tensor products to sums of Ext classes.

Realizing Ext classes as shifted single morphisms preserves addition. The exact derived change of site preserves addition, as do pre- and postcomposition with the fixed integer and units comparisons. Applying these generic transport identities gives the stated lineBundleEtaleClass equation.
